name: One click video screenshot extraction - 一键视频截图提取
description: One-click video screenshot capture. Supports major streaming sites, auto-saves HD images. No extra tools needed.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:;
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; child-src 'self'; worker-src 'self';
